items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: And Rappaport, he was on Alcatraz; you know, he was in prison!

ctx.x: amazing how they located these recordings, because I didn't know anybody who knew where they were. And Rappaport, he was on Alcatraz; you know, he was in prison! I said, 'How could they find these records?' They never told me how they found these records, you know, after all of that time. They reissued them in about 1974 or '75; they reissued them then. [LAUGHS]
